source_caption:
📺 Girl Meets World (2014–2017)

Girl Meets World follows Riley Matthews, the optimistic teenage daughter of Cory and Topanga Matthews, as she navigates the challenges of growing up in New York City. Alongside her rebellious best friend Maya Hart, Riley experiences school adventures, complicated friendships, romantic feelings, and important life lessons. With her father Cory serving as her history teacher, Riley often discovers meaningful connections between classroom lessons and everyday experiences. Together with their friends Lucas Friar and Farkle Minkus, Riley and Maya learn to overcome personal challenges and embrace their individuality. Starring Rowan Blanchard, Sabrina Carpenter, Ben Savage, and Danielle Fishel, the series continues the beloved story of Boy Meets World, combining nostalgic moments, entertaining comedy, and heartfelt storytelling while exploring friendship, family, young love, identity, and personal growth.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family • Teen Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 23 minutes per episode • TV-G

🎥 Creators: Michael Jacobs & April Kelly

📺 Seasons: 3 • 72 Episodes

📚 Spin-off of: Boy Meets World (1993–2000).

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ (United States).

source_details.synopsis: Girl Meets World is an American sitcom created by Michael Jacobs and April Kelly that premiered on Disney Channel on June 27, 2014. The series ran for three seasons, consisting of 72 episodes, and concluded on January 20, 2017. The series is a spin-off of Boy Meets World and stars Rowan Blanchard, Ben Savage, Sabrina Carpenter, Peyton Meyer, August Maturo, Danielle Fishel, and Corey Fogelmanis. The series centers around the life of Riley and her friends and family, particularly their school life, in which Cory is their history teacher.
